Implement median_filter(readings) to compute the median reading of readings, robust to spikes.
code:
def median_filter(readings):
    s = sorted(readings)
    n = len(s)
    mid = n // 2
    if n % 2 == 1:
        return s[mid]
    return (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2
